29-giveback-ledger.title: THE GIVE-BACK LEDGER: THE DAY'S PEAK IS WATERMARKED, THE EROSION LEADS THE VOICE, AND A REALIZED SWING TIGHTENS THE GUARD ONCE (Sep 29, giveback-ledger)
29-giveback-ledger.detail: The user report: "Gave back $100 but doesn't count it? We were up $100 today, now we are back to +$2 — nothing adjusted. Says 'All Good' without checking what we gave back first." TRIAGE: the swing was REALIZED (the account went negative intraday and recovered); the ground truth showed +$39.44 banked total with only +$4.62 in applied journal rows — the gap is the open book's swing plus the window's prior carries — and NOTHING in the stack measured a day's peak-to-trough: the gauges sum realized rows, the danger machinery only reacts to losses vs the START balance, and the per-pair give-back warning (GIVEBACK_WARN_PCT_OF_SIZE, Sep 1) dies with each row's close. THE FIX, four layers: (1) _today_realized_pnl — the shared realized sum. (2) _track_day_giveback — a day-peak watermark (realized + unrealized, fed the exit cycle's per-row usd sum every tick, BEFORE the exit early-return so a full-exit tick updates the give-back) persisted in profit_guard_state under 'giveback'; past the $50 trigger it tightens the guard ONCE through auto_adjust.apply_adjustment — the PROTECTIVE direction (negative delta = factor down = tighter trail; the only direction the machine admits, verified against its non_negative_delta_is_not_self_adjust rail) — one attempt per day whatever the outcome (applied/queued/refused all land a ledger row; refusals never re-fire), telemetry emitted, rotation_id giveback-<day>. (3) _all_good_lead rewritten: the erosion LEADS ("Gave back 95 dollars from the day's peak — we were up 100, now plus 5") and 'All good' never prefixes it; the realized pace clause rides after; under the $25 speak floor the line stays All good. (4) PINS in test_allgoodlead (now 26 checks): the lead shape, the never-lie rule, the small-erosion silence, the tracker's protective direction, and the no-refire — with the guard state SANDBOXED via STATE_FILE and apply_adjustment mocked (the live scanner's state was never touched). Drives: allgoodlead 26/0, persistexit DONE, autotrack 43/43, trailstop 27/0, rebootsurv 25/0, profitguard 77/0, boundaryexam 35/0. PENDING: the running scanner (pid from scanner_pulse.json) picks the ledger up on its next restart.
